query: What operational burdens appear in incident descriptions?

per_column.name: incident_type
per_column.rationale: Classifies the technical category of the incident (email, database, network). This describes WHAT KIND of incident occurred, not an aspect of the burden it imposes. It is a predictor/context variable, not a part-of operational_burden.

per_column.name: severity_signal
per_column.rationale: Severity/impact magnitude (single_user to widespread_impact) is a genuine constitutive aspect of how burdensome an incident is; the intensity dimension of operational burden.

per_column.name: infrastructure_component
per_column.rationale: Identifies the affected component (vpn, server, wifi). This is the object involved, a contextual descriptor, not an aspect of the burden itself. It also largely duplicates incident_type.

per_column.name: operational_burden_aspect
per_column.rationale: Named as 'aspect' but its values (connectivity_loss, data_access_blocked, service_degradation) describe the symptom/failure type of the incident, effectively restating the incident nature rather than decomposing burden into a distinct facet; it overlaps heavily with incident_type/infrastructure_component.

per_column.name: scope_of_impact
per_column.rationale: Breadth of affected population (individual to company_wide) is a legitimate constitutive facet of operational burden (its reach/extent). However it substantially overlaps with severity_signal, which encodes essentially the same impact-breadth dimension.

per_column.name: resolution_pattern
per_column.rationale: Effort/handling pattern (cross_team_handoff, reassigned, self_resolved) reflects the workload/coordination cost aspect of operational burden, a valid constitutive facet capturing effort intensity.

per_column.name: recurrent_issue_flag
per_column.rationale: Recurrence is a genuine dimension of burden (chronic/repeated load vs one-off), constituting the persistence aspect of operational burden.

judge.rationale: Only four of seven columns are true constitutive facets of operational_burden. incident_type and infrastructure_component are external/context descriptors (what/where the incident is, not the burden), and they duplicate each other. operational_burden_aspect, despite its name, restates the incident symptom type rather than adding a distinct facet, again overlapping with the two type columns. Among the genuine facets, severity_signal and scope_of_impact both encode impact breadth, reducing mutual exclusivity. The facet set covers severity, scope, effort, and recurrence but omits aspects like duration/downtime and business/cost impact, so exhaustiveness is only moderate. The heavy conceptual overlap and presence of predictors/restatements yield low MECE scores.
